careers.name: Frontend Developer
careers.description: Build accessible screens, interactive forms, and responsive interfaces. Example: a room-booking dashboard.

careers.name: Backend Developer
careers.description: Design APIs, validate requests, and store reliable data. Example: booking endpoints and transactions.

careers.name: Full-stack Developer
careers.description: Connect interfaces, APIs, and databases. Example: an end-to-end reservation feature.

careers.name: Software Engineer
careers.description: Design maintainable application logic and tests. Example: a reusable scheduling module.

careers.name: Data Analyst
careers.description: Clean business data and communicate patterns. Example: reporting room usage and peak hours.

careers.name: Data Scientist
careers.description: Explore data and evaluate predictive models. Example: forecasting booking demand with uncertainty.

careers.name: Data Engineer
careers.description: Build pipelines and dependable datasets. Example: loading reservation events into a warehouse.

careers.name: AI Engineer
careers.description: Integrate model capabilities into evaluated applications. Example: a help assistant with structured responses.

careers.name: Machine Learning Engineer
careers.description: Train, deploy, and monitor models. Example: a demand prediction service with drift checks.

careers.name: DevOps Engineer
careers.description: Automate delivery and improve reliability. Example: a tested deployment pipeline with monitoring.

careers.name: Cloud Engineer
careers.description: Design cloud networks, compute, and storage. Example: a secure, cost-aware booking service.

careers.name: Cybersecurity Analyst
careers.description: Investigate threats and reduce risks. Example: detecting suspicious booking access and planning a response.
